headline: Io Beta 0.8.2
intro: Io Beta 0.8.2: the changes since Beta 0.8.1.
notes: Desktop: Plasma 6.8.3 with Io's patches; the lock screen has its own on-screen keyboard again.
Graphics: Valve's newest RADV changes: DX12 games bind sparse resources in one step, the waiting is done by the kernel.
Wi-Fi: after standby, other networks show up at once when the previous one is not in range.
Desktop mode: Steam's new desktop session name starts Io's desktop.
